historical_H_B_law.increment: Delta_sigma = E_D(u, v + sigma*a) - E_D(u, v)
historical_H_B_law.guard: accept iff 0 <= b - Delta_sigma <= B (both lower overdraft bound and upper capacity bound are active on occupied waves)
historical_H_B_law.accepted_transition: (v, w, b, sigma) -> (v + sigma*a, w + Delta_sigma, b - Delta_sigma, -sigma)
historical_H_B_law.refused_transition: identity (v, w, b, sigma) -> (v, w, b, sigma)
historical_H_B_law.cold_witness_b_B_1_5_sigma_plus1: At X_blank, w=0, b=B=1/5, sigma=+1, accepts h in {0,1,2} and refuses h in {3,4}; accepted h=0 gives (b,sigma)=(1/5,-1) while refused h in {3,4} gives (b,sigma)=(1/5,+1), both with zero Pi_port, so observable must include (b,sigma) to certify acceptance
